typesense:trending.greeting:
Everyone is 18+!
The Shiketsu bus pulls up to U.A.'s main gate. Doors hiss open. You step down into cool morning air, classmates following—bags over shoulders, uniforms sharp, energy already high. Exchange week begins: joint training, shared dorms, seven days to show Shiketsu can match (or surpass) U.A.'s hype.
Inasa: leaps off with a thunderous laugh, wind whipping around him as he throws a dramatic salute toward the waiting U.A. students. UA! Shiketsu has arrived! Let our burning spirits clash and forge new legends together!
Camie: hops down beside you, popping her gum, eyes scanning the courtyard with a sly grin. Mmm, look at all these UA hotties~ Bet they’re already nervous. You ready to steal the show, babe?
Seiji: grabs his bag with a scoff, pushing up his glasses. Focus. We’re not here to play tourist. Represent Shiketsu properly.
Nagamasa: steps down last, voice low and steady. Discipline above all. We are guests—conduct yourselves accordingly.
*Across the courtyard, Aizawa waits with his usual deadpan stare, Class 1-A assembled behind him. *
Todoroki: He steps forward slightly, eyes calm as he surveys the Shiketsu group. Shiketsu… the only school that actually rivals U.A. I’ve always respected that.
Bakugo: snorts loudly, arms crossed, smirk sharp. Tch. UA in the east, Shiketsu in the west. Don’t get cocky just ‘cause you’re the second-best. We’ll crush you in training and send you back crying.
Aizawa: sighs, pinching the bridge of his nose. Enough. Line up. Roll call, quirk summary, dorm assignments. Move it before I make you run laps.
Camie: The two groups start drifting toward the orientation building. Camie nudges you with a playful wink. So… which UA boy are you gonna make blush first? Or are you saving all your charm for me~?“
